item.text: {"search_note":"I found no direct evidence of nuclear-war crisis management, hotline use, accidental-war prevention, or special deconfliction channels in 2024. The record was mixed but slightly positive on de-escalation and crisis communication: Tinubu sometimes used conciliatory, channel-preserving language, but also used forceful coercive rhetoric in domestic security incidents.","evidence":[{"title":"President Tinubu Calls for Suspension of Sanctions on Guinea, Mali, Niger, Burkina Faso","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"February 24, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-calls-for-suspension-of-sanctions-on-guinea-mali-niger-burkina-faso/","summary":"Tinubu argued that sanctions had become ineffective and called for “a better path” through negotiation and improved governance. This is the clearest de-escalatory move in the record and suggests a preference for keeping diplomatic channels open.","question_ids":["1B.8","1B.4","1B.1","1B.2"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Meets FBI Director, Calls for Stronger Collaboration to Fight Cybercrime and Terrorism","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"June 14, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-meets-fbi-director-calls-for-stronger-collaboration-to-fight-cybercrime-and-terrorism/","summary":"Tinubu publicly called for closer cooperation on terrorism and cybercrime and framed collaboration as part of his administration’s response. This is relevant crisis behavior because it preserves operational channels and favors coordination over unilateral escalation.","question_ids":["1B.8","1B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu’s Broadcast on the Nationwide Protest","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"August 4, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-broadcast-on-the-nationwide-protest/","summary":"Tinubu acknowledged deaths, destruction, and unrest tied to the protests and addressed the public directly. That communication was a clear attempt to manage a major domestic crisis, though it was not a de-escalatory concession in substance.","question_ids":["1B.8","1B.5","1B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu’s Statement on the Killings of Soldiers in Aba","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"June 2, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-statement-on-the-killings-of-soldiers-in-aba/","summary":"Tinubu said the government would “come down heavily” on attackers and that the armed forces had the capacity to crush violent non-state actors. This is further negative context for 1B.8 because it signals a hard-security approach rather than a consistently channel-preserving crisis posture.","question_ids":["1B.8","1B.5"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Mourns Victims of Tanker Fire Incident in Rivers State","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"April 28, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-mourns-victims-of-tanker-fire-incident-in-rivers-state/","summary":"Tinubu directed federal support for victims and said stricter safety regulations would be implemented to prevent similar tragedies. While not an interstate crisis, this shows crisis communication paired with a preventive policy response.","question_ids":["1B.8","1B.3"]}]}
